author: leolara
content:
Happy to collaborate on this 🙂 I am currently working full time on Etheorem so it is doable.

The idea is not to make a complete python to Lean4 translator, that would be a huge endeavor.

The idea is to translate from the subset of python and framework of the specs into a specs framework in Lean4. So first we need to implement manually (with help of AI), such framework and at least one port. The peanas becomes a sync layer between both. This is not that complex, as it is a delimited subset of python in the context of an specific framework. I have done similar work previously, for example in https://github.com/privacy-ethereum/chiquito 

We have that precondition already implemented for mainline consensus, we started there because it is less complex than Execution.

However, as you are having interest we will spike doing this for Execution, and shift our attention to that for a bit. So the first fruit will be a port of EELS for one fork in Lean4. Then "paenas" can keep them in sync.

author: leolara
content: Another note to everyone, if you know someone that is interested in starting on Ethereum core development with Lean4, please invite them to come and contribute. Qualified candidates will receive mentorship from Invisible Garden (https://invisible.garden/) . In Invisible Garden discord: https://discord.gg/m3uY74kAr there is a Etheorem channel.
